info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Relationship Management API
info.description: The Customer Relationship Management API facilitates the maintenance and enhancement of customer relationships by allowing businesses to update customer information and manage interactions effectively. With this API, users can perform actions such as altering customer details and managing preferences, helping to streamline customer service operations. It is typically utilized by CRM systems and customer service platforms to ensure that customer data is accurate and up-to-date. This API is crucial for organizations aiming to improve customer engagement and satisfaction.
